notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.1.3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Re-added kingdom statistics menu (view logistics and details regarding production in your kingdom).
[*] Added keybinds for each menu option.
[*] Localization fixes.
[*] Load bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch notes for version 0.1.2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Camera controls are now enabled when viewing the queue. 
[*] AI nerfed during start of games. Buffer time added before combat.
[*] Players start with the first 5 foundational technologies pre-researched.
[*] UI Warning + bell rings when enemies approach your kingdom.
[*] Stone prices on buildings lowered.
[*] Late game buildings will be built faster.
[*] AI defenders bug fixes.
[*] Font fix for localized Simplified Chinese.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.1.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Can use [Escape] key to cancel build 
[*] Added "All-Knowing" achievement
[*] Fixed boat movement/unit interaction bug
[*] Rebalanced late game research
[*] Fixed other minor bugs
[/list]
